review_description: The sales / quoting process was efficient, the installers were polite, tidy and punctual and the whole process was easy

Rob from Living Energy gave me honest advice regarding south facing panels and their quote was very reasonable. One of the big brand installer quoted 1500 higher price for just panels and inverter (I requested to add battery 1 week before installation).My roof, got very limited space, so installation team did really good job when hiding cables.

Choosing a local installer was important to me. The quoting process quick & efficient. The site visit was punctual & thorough. Although there was looming covid supply chain issue, they installed as discussed in the timeframe quoted.Installation staff were polite a tidy. Ben ensured I was properly setup with the app. Origin Energy were booked in the next day for smart meter install, where Living Energy were also required to tee up new isolator. Overall communication was very sound:)Thank You Solar Quotes for a brilliant web site.

Sales person was great, timely and informative once we have received the quotes. Enjoyed the process and patience from the sales person as they did not make me feel silly for asking questions. Customer service once we decided to go ahead could be improved. I felt like communications went silent after we had paid the deposit and lacking updates or check-ins towards the lead up of installation. Being not too familiar with the process I would've appreciated a few phone calls or emails here and there. The installation team was great - despite the weather, the team onsite were cheerful, friendly, and efficient. Also, very tidy. My only concern at the moment is that despite installing a 10kw, I've very rarely seen it recording 5kw  on the inverter even on the sunniest of days.
Sales and install was good and quick. Grid connection will be happening soon.

The sales person, Rob, was very thorough in designing the panel placement with me as there were some issues with tree shade over the different seasons that some of the other sales people discounted or offered expensive solutions for. He responded intelligently and readily to all my questions throughout the sales process. I felt he was genuine and explained technical details clearly and discussed options respectfully so I could make informed decisions. Also I referred to the SolarQuotes website to confirm information or know what questions to ask about the different options for panels and inverters. It was good to get 3 other quotes, which were all in a similar ballpark but with differing panels or inverters and I learned from each one.I didn’t want the ‘best’ system, rather value for money. I have had a system since 2008 (Solar Shop) which is still in place with an SMA inverter and had no problems (other than trees I let grow!) so I was keen to have SMA again but with more efficient up to date panels.The installation was smooth: on time, clear arrangements, polite, tidy, efficient yet friendly. All information and paperwork provided. The new system was switched on the same day as I already had everything required. Their IT guy helped me set up the app and everything seems to be working as expected ie generating the predicted kWh daily.Overall it was an efficient yet pleasant experience from start to finish. Everyone at Living Energy I dealt with was polite, focused, intelligent and responsive. Everything happened as predicted so their internal communication and business systems function well too.

I would definitely recommend Living Energy Solutions to my friends as I feel Rob from the company is very knowledgeable and gives practical advice about the system I should be getting instead of just aiming to profit from selling me the system.
Sales person was knowledgeable and happy to spend time discussing my priorities. Installation team were professional. Just waiting for a sunny day to check system performance !

Very happy to be introduced to Living Energy thru Solar Quotes. They were easy to deal with and quick to reply and visit our house and Quote . I was happy with the options offered and their prices were very competitive. I did ask some of the Questions as suggested by Solar Quotes and was happy to get positive answers to all of them. Gave me confidence to proceed and the installation guys were on time , pleasant and the job is very tidy as expected. We now have the meter installed and and Living Energy returned to set up the wifi / cloud monitoring etc .Even in the middle of an Adelaide winter the system is performing very well. - Dave Hillcrest SA

Everything went smoothly, installed on the day they said they would. Installation was over two days due to weather conditions (pouring rain) they kept me informed of the progress. The invertor was placed where I had requested without any issues. When the job was finished, they tidied up, and removed any rubbish and had organised for Origin to replace meter.
Professional sales team, competitive pricing, quality installation and effective customer service.

The person I spoke to was clear and good at explaining the company and the process. They had just finished a large country installation, so had 25 staff ready to go - so I figured a small domestic system would not be a challenge, and they could get it up quickly. This they did. The only holdup was the electricity company doing the final switching g - but we had been warned about this in advance. So all good.

I chose this installer from 3 quotes because the quote is very clear and with as many options as possible. The other 2 installers called me instantly after quotes but they made mistakes in answering my questions. I replied to Living Energy to set a time for site checking. I found the salesman dependable and steady-going. It made me go forward to sign a contract at once. The whole process is quick. They spent 3 weeks to contact electricity retailer, apply for credit and so on. On the day of installation, the workers worked efficient and in a professional way. It is a satisfying company and I will recommend to my friends.

I actually got a further 4 quotes outside of solarquotes (that were still recommended by solarquotes) and I found Living Energy's mix of service, pricing and range to be the best.Install went well without any fuss. Proof in the pudding but very happy to date!

Sales process: OK. Sales rep asked good questions, made good suggestions. Some quoting tools (like proposed roof layout diagram) did not work very well (PV panel sizes on a high rake roof were not accurate). Salesman not aware of some layout restrictions caused by the racking system used by the company.Installation: Went well. Both the installer foreman and the electrician encountered on-site issues which should have been clear to the sales rep. Both needed to modify the proposed installation. We discussed options, and they found good ways to implement the system I wanted using different approaches. Full marks to both.Customer service: since installation, has been good. (System installed 21 January 2020.)

Living Energy Solutions were prompt with their quote and willing to answer all my questions.  The quote was well set out and gave me some choices about the components used. The installers were prompt and polite, and worked well as a team.  I admired their application to the task in 37 degree heat, and by the end of the day, the system was installed.  They cleaned up well, and left the site in good condition. All arrangements were made with my electrical supply company who then contacted me to complete the connection to the grid.  It all proceeded very smoothly and without any hitches.

Chris from Living Energy was so helpful in explaining the various inverters and panels they were offering, and it was great to have options with the quotes. I was impressed with the really professional work done by the team from Lovell Electrical with notifying the power company, the installation, the clean up, and organising the grid connection after the install.

The company provided a comprehensive written quotation very quickly. Our questions and queries were answered by telephone . The installation process happened within 2weeks and we were happy with the service and efficiency of the installation team the system is functioning well and we are happy with our choice.
All OK, Living Energy did what the said they were going to do and the system works well enough.Installation had some minor hiccups but ended up OK..

Was contacted promptly by salesperson who was professional and informative. No hard sell - gave me all the options and answered all my many questions. Installation team left the place cleaner than they found it. Arrived when they said they would. Salesperson followed up a few days later to check I was happy and answer any further questions. Made it all easy!

Even if I received the quotation, only after I reminded them, the process was ok, the quotation including several options.The installation team was very punctual, they worked tidy, fast and well. I highly recommend this company!
Happy with sales service and installation. Very thorough. Had a few tree isues but happy with the outcome.   Good company to deal with.       Thank you
Great customer service. Rob will get back and help resolve the issue and answering querries.
Got the solaredge and rec panels also the optimisers.
I have just purchased for a new build home so we havenâ€™t progressed past deposit stage as yet.
All aspects very good. All promises and assurances kept and honoured.
They were very professional and helped answer all of my questions. Once the system was installed they even rang to make sure everything was working well.

Rob came over and we both jumped up on our roof. Our home was built in 1900 with several extensions, of which are different roof lines.After numerous plans we came up with the best option for us.We have now had the system on for about a week and we are very happy with the output. More than what was expected!The boys that installed the system were extremely polite and professional.

Sales process was easy with no pressure applied and all information clearly explained.  Installers arrived on time and were polite and very tidy.  A comprehensive user guide and warranty information was provided post installation.  Living Energy were also the only respondee familiar with Solar Analytics.

Rob from Living Energy Solutions was professional, prompt with communications, answered every question I had in great detail and importantly was the only company that did a site visit prior to quoting. As soon as he looked at my roof, he told me straight away that normal portrait layout wouldn't work due to the spacing of purlins. This attention to detail was reflected in a realistic system design and accurate quote. We were offered various panel and inverter options and settled on a system that met all our requirements. Installation day went by very smoothly, safely, on time and left very tidy. Paperwork for the meter change was all completed for us by Living Energy and was carried out as requested 2 weeks later. All aspects of our system including our solar analytics monitoring were explained and warranty, manuals followed soon after electronically. I would highly recommend Living Energy Solutions to anyone looking for a high quality solar installation.

As a landlord I wanted to install solar to do a bit more for the environment and do my bit to make use of a couple more vacant roofs we have in Adelaide. Not being directly involved with the installation we can't make a too detailed comments on the installation. But, it all seemed to be faultless, arrived as they said they would and seemed to have the job done pretty promptly. The tenants have advised that the systems are already saving them money, so, a little less fossil fuels being used in S.A.The price was in the ball park with other installers, the system is of reasonable quality and affordable. (read the Solar Quotes reviews)The problem with not residing in the properties is, follow up with the retailers to change the meters is not smooth.Chris Toms of Living Energy made the whole procedure quite easy and communications were prompt.

The process was extremely slow - 3 months from the time we ordered and paid our deposit.  I assume the overall system quality is good but truthfully there is no way to really know in the short term but it is now working, so we remain optimistic.  The Living Energy salesman was the only one to visit and actually see our situation (the others used Google maps).  The installation trades folk were personable, efficient and seemed capable, though the meter box work needed revision - delaying our system start another 2 weeks.  SA Power Networks new meter installers were most helpful.
Follow up has been a little slow but otherwise it has ben great.

I had one quote that bothered me - the sales person raised many red herrings regarding the other company's choices which on further examination were either incorrect or simply not relevant.  Another company went for a very hard sell and when told their quote was too high immediately reduced it by $2k.  I found some were using old panels that had been superseded presumably bought in a job lot.  Its a strangely stressful experience overall. We went with the company that did the most research for us and were straightforward and not pushy salespeople.
Company was great about solar &we have stuck with power company we also get our power. Many thanks for time and effort.

The Salesperson was very helpful and spent a lot of time explaining the system and questions about various panels and inverters. The job was completed within a few weeks, the Installers were professional and clean explained how to work everything when the job was finished.

The sales process was consultative, open and honest. Ben went through more than ten separate scenarios for us providing real world up-front costs as well as conservative estimates on the payback periods for different panel types and system sizes as we changed our mind several times regarding system size / panel color and upgrading to panels carrying a warranty for salt damage as we live on West Lakes.  Once a decision was made, the design was formulated from a set of software tools to ensure the correct number of panels were installed on each side of our roof to maximise the efficiency of the system. The installation was faultless, with David and his team consulting me on every step of the process to ensure that the inverter was located where we wanted it and how all cabling etc should be run for aesthetics. Even at the completion of the job when they had packed up, David realised our TV antenna would cast a shadow over a couple of panels in the morning and spent the next hour relocating it. I ended up installing a 12.5kw system and could not be happier with the experience of dealing with Living Energy

Suntrix and LES got in touch within a day. Solar after a week so I did not ask them (it was too late). Suntrix and LES both very pleasant/knowledgeable salesmen. The system offered was very similar so the decision was on price only. System installed just today (coincidentally). 6 hour job, mid 30's temperature. Job done well, courteously. The couple of small problems were dealt with and fully communicated. Shown how the system worked. Cleaned up after themselves. Overall excellent.
I would be happy to provide more information once I have had my system installed which should be early in the new year

Generally OK...quick responses from all 3 potential suppliers.Prices were high, perhaps $1000 or more in comparison with other well regarded installers. (friends were getting quotes at a the same time).I'm happy enough.... but should have negotiated a lot harder.I'm now waiting for Power SA to do its thing.SolaQuotes was nothing but helpful and the whole process has been relatively smooth...

They were the only company to use a solar camera to predict degree of shading effect. They offered several options ad gave enough help to make an informed choice. The installation team took less time to do the job than quoted without taking any shortcuts. They gave a good explanation of what the were doing and how the installed system would work. Overall it was a positive experience and outcome.

THESE GUYS ARE GOOD THEY KNOW WHAT THEY ARE TALKING ABOUT. THEY WILL HELP YOU WITH THE PRICE AND ANY ASSISTANCE  YOU NEED. THEY COME TO YOUR HOUSE, MEASURE UP AND TALK TO YOU,  VERY PROFESSIONAL PEOPLE!!!   I DID A LOT OF HOMEWORK TO FIND THE RIGHT SOLAR INSTALLER TO CHOOSE FROM AND WITH YOUR GUIDANCE I FOUND THEM. FINN PEACOCK I  THANKYOU FOR YOUR INFORMATION ON SOLAR IT WAS  VERY HELPFUL TO ME. REGARDS   JANETTE CAIN

Living Energy were the cheapest but with the same quality components as per the other quotes. I was careful when comparing quotes to compare apples with apples so to speak. Not only were they the cheapest but they had a very good down to earth sales manner and communication. I felt that Living Energy had a very good and detailed product knowledge that was slightly above the competitors. They were also very receptive to some changes I wanted to make to the installation location of the inverter. Their installation was first rate.
Being fitted this week , there was a long delay  between accepting quote and installation time

We have been very impressed with each process of dealing with all staff. From the original quote to a re quote, organising new meter box and quick friendly installation. We highly recommend Living Energy Solutions.

We had 5 quotes, one appeared to be a really nice guy who was going to save us thousands; but I discovered some wrong/dishonest advice.  Another placed too much pressure on me and I didn't quite understand what the end process would be.  Then my son googled and found Solar Quotes.  All three referred from Solar Quotes were fantastic and it was hard to say no to the two unsucessful quotes because they worked so professionally.  We went with the dearerst of the three - only $300 more - because while the other two were completely professional with excellent systems; and I understood everything they were sharing with me; the successful tender spent an extra half an hour with my wife explaining how the system and electricity billing process worked.  The other two would have spent the extra time if asked, but the successful guys proactively sensed my wife had not let go of some false information provided by the first company.   I felt settling the doubt was worth the little bit extra.

Consultants spent several hours at my home designing and discussing the system I wanted (AC system) with panel layout to suit my energy usage pattern and roof layout prior to providing quote. The installation crew were very efficient and friendly and answered all my questions. System was installed ahead of scheduled date due to a cancellation.
Every part of the solar purchase/installation experience went like clockwork. I couldn't be more happy with the whole process.

Very good company reps who came out to our house to give a personal quote instead of by google earth like so many others.  Kept us up to date through the whole process prior to installation date.  Installers arrived on time and were very professional and helpful and gave us lots of useful information. Actual installation is top quality using very good components.  Reassured us not to hesitate to contact them if we had any further questions.  Would highly recommend Living Energy Solutions.

We chose Living Energy Solutions as they were very helpful and informative at every stage of the process.  We chose a good value for money system and installation was carried out on time and to specification.  We are very happy with the end result!!
Installation was on time and efficient. Friendly staff and good after sale service.

Good salespeople, well-informed and helpful.Very quick with installation.Unfortunate time-lag with forms incorrectly filled out in order to get new meter installed, this issue was managed well, however. Couldn't fault customer service.
The installation price included a up grade to the power board.

We have taken a long time to choose the system we want but the people at Living Energy Solutions have been very patient and very helpful to give us a fantastic system. They also provided us with lots of options and great advise

The installers turned up on time on the day, introduced themselves (the whole 6 of them) and were extremely professional, made the minimum of noise and did a removal of all rubbish and cleaned the site.  I would highly recommend this company to anyone who was considering solar panels.  They were not the cheapest of my quotes, but the old saying goes.  "You only get what you pay for".

This comany (Living Energy Solutions) was truly straight-forward and patient in how they dealt with us as potential and as signed-up clients. There was no 'hard sell' during the quotation stage, and the sales team was responsive to queries by email after the initial site visit. The installation team was punctual and considerate, and importantly they did not rush their work but rather, took the time needed to explain, consult and demonstrate. We are very pleased with the system we chose, and look forward to seeing how it performs in service.
Our main issues were dealing with SA Power Networks - as a monopoly provider they are very frustrating to deal with - they have no concept of customer service.
Great after sales services. Excellent at cleaning up after, great professional sales and service.
Excellent customer service. Installers were skilled and accommodating. A couple of minor issues arose on site but these were resolved satisfactorily.

Little disappointed we have to wait extra four weeks for installation. The meter change has already been done. For the price we are getting Solalog installed and this is a good deal; other quotes for this system were higher. Fingers crossed on installation

Ben from Living Energy was really thorough in his assessment of the possible options and how to optimise the benefits of a PV system, much more so than any other supplier, and this encouraged trust, as well as their price being cost-competitive.
Installer were willing to come to the country to do installation with no additional costs.
No - very happy so far & would recommend installer to anyone that cares to listen.

Within minutes of me requesting some quotes for the installation of Solar Panels I received a call from Ben Lovell from Living Energy Solutions.Ben is a very knowledgeable person regards the products he sells. He is a very honest person to deal with.David Lovell installed the unit and did a fantastic job. My home is a Heritage Bungalow, David did everything possible to fit the system and make it aesthetically pleasing.Jodie in the office is a bubbly helpful person a great asset to Living Energy Solutions.I highly recommend Living Energy Solutions for all your Solar Energy need.
Good advice and a willingness to listen, educate us and understand our specific situation and motivation.

Prepared to pay for the privilege of working with a reasonably local, family based company. I liked the way the brothers kept up to date. with changes in the field. Care taken to position the panels and lots of advice given on how tree growth and TV antenna could influence performance and what to do about it. Ben had a devise which would map the path of the sun over the 12 months and use it to predict which trees etc., would compromise panel performance.

The information we received from all three companies we were referred to was very comprehensive and clear.  The quotes were quite comparable but the service provided by Living Energy was excellent.The experience has been smooth and painless and we are very happy with the pre-sale information, installation and after sales service.

I would certainly recommend Living Energy to anyone looking to install a PV system. They were not the cheapest but they were upfront about everything. They provided the best quality system with the best quality components that would meet my power needs and that I could afford with no extra hidden costs. If they said that they would come out on a certain date and time to quote/install, they were there on time. Customer service at its best!

I would recommend Living Energy Solutions to anyone looking for a solar system. I found Ben and David very helpful in providing enough information to make an informed decision. They listened to our concerns about the location and appearance and performance of the system and came up with a great solution. We were very happy with the intallation, very efficient and tidy work. The system is working above my expections.

I got the system I wanted and I was very set on how I wanted it installed.The price I paid was average between the highest and lowest.I googled the panels and inverter and bought the best I could find.

As with any purchase, I wanted to avoid the TV ads for solar power. Using the Solar Quotes website gave me 3 options that saved me a lot of running around. I did source quotes outside of this process for comparison, and I would recommend anyone to read up on the subject themselves, to see through any sales pitches.All in all, a pleasant experience, and a great end result!

I was, as the survey indicates, that I was exceptionally  pleased with the total purchasing presentation of the product, the installing and the clear communication between all.  I have written a letter of appreciation to the management of the company, something that I don't often do, but I believe that it was needed in this case. I do hope that they can make use of the letter and it serves them well in some form or another.I had already discussed a new system with the company who had installed my small system some ten years ago; from January this year they were selling very good systems and at competitive rate and i was prepared to go with them; once out tax returns came in. When we had the money, they were selling rubbish. One event after another led to them not providing the panels that i wanted; because according to management, they no longer sold them or had a similar quality panel. Needless to say I started looking elsewhere.Of the three who were suppose to call and present their submission. One rang and was to call again but i never heard of him after that, the other consultant didn't get in touch at all; his manager called some weeks later wanting to discus when he had made contact with me, and how our discussions went;  he was apparently not approaching all contacts but only those who would bring in a greater profit for him;  the later is a little disturbing for the industry.The person from living energy solutions made contact, an appointment, turned up on time and gave an exceptional presentation.

My overall experience with Living Energy Solution is very good.  Ben answered my questions well and was keen to explain things I didn't quite understand.  He took the time.  The intallation was very professional and tidy.  So far, I am thrilled with the performance of the system.

We went with Living Energy Solutions because Ben was honest and up front with us throughout the whole process, even suggesting that we would get a good system and good service if we chose to go with one of the other companies we got a quote from (Solar 2000), both companies were very good, in the end it was very line ball which company we would go with, the final deciding factor was Bens frankness and that for around a $1000 we could get an extra 1.4Kw which would ensure we fully covered our electricity use, something we didn't think we could afford.The install went smoothly and the team were excellent, they were happy for me to watch every little thing they did and their attention to detail was outstanding, the whole process from quote to install went smoothly and painlessly.I am more than happy to recommend Living Energy Solutions.

Both solar suppliers I recieved quotes from I would recommend, LIVING ENERGY SOLUTIONS AND SOLAR 2000. BUT BEN from LIVING ENERGY SOLUTIONS turned up when he said he would he also explaind each products pros and cons so I felt confident making my mind up. LIVING ENERGY SOLUTIONS price was a bit higher but when informed of this they priced matched. The install happened on the date and time set no mess no fuss. Looks good, works good. COULD NOT FAULT ANY PART OF THE PROCESS.

From the first point of contact with Ben was fantastic.  He explained everything thoroughly in terms that I understood, wasn't pushy and A1 in everything that I would expect from a salesperson.  The workmen installed everything in half a day and were everything was explained to me on how the panels worked.All in all a great experience and would recommend the whole team to anybody.
Sales person was knowledgeable and instilled confidence. The system installation went smoothly and the results in terms of power generated so far have been impressive.
Quite painless. Both Ben and Dave were very helpful and had the system installed with a minimum of fuss.
Living Energy Solutions, quality of service so far very good.
